goal: Prevent mempool dynamic memory undercounting for unbroadcast local transactions
Provides accurate memory reporting and strict enforcement of the configured mempool limit
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by testing memory accounting and test coverage (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: mempool
why: P4 because the memory undercounting is minor at roughly eighty bytes per unbroadcast transaction
Impact on node memory limit enforcement and reporting is negligible under normal operation
